title: Nested burial assembly — four Meshy shrines, stone sarcophagus, three coffins
generation: Meshy smart topology, meshy-t2 geometry and meshy-n1 textures; four generated color reconstruction references based on artifact photographs. 60 Meshy credits total.
shrineDimensions: Maximum cornice extents from Carter records guide display size; the second shrine's maximum roof height is an approximate display value. Generated roof profiles, inscriptions, unseen sides and wall thickness are not measured replicas.
sarcophagusAdjustment: Only the existing stone sarcophagus surfaces are reparented, turned 90 degrees to a west–east long axis, and fitted to a 2.76 × 1.62 × 1.48 m display envelope. Original tomb geometry and all wall assets remain unchanged.
sarcophagusDimensionsLimit: The cited dimensions describe the recorded facsimile. Fitting the older simplified stone model to that envelope is a teaching adjustment, not a new scan or verified reconstruction of its interior.
coffinAssembly: nested-coffins-ai.glb — existing three teacher-supplied Meshy coffin models; same constructed cavities and lids, with the wrapped mummy, mask, crook and flail inserted at runtime. Placed with the head west and a display base at y=0.64 m.
gameInteraction: Burial layers reveals the four enclosing shrines, then the stone sarcophagus, then the three nested coffins. Explore nested coffins opens the existing full-size teaching copies. The fixed coffin assembly is temporarily hidden during that activity to avoid a duplicate display. Enclosed objects retain their nested transforms but are culled until revealed, avoiding unseen-surface artifacts in the generated shells.
removedFromGame: The old anthropoid souvenir coffin replica. Its shared source file remains because the Anubis shrine uses another component from it.
notIncluded: The separate pall and its framework (208–209) are not modeled in this assembly. Other objects placed between shrines are not reconstructed.
accuracy: Illustrative game reconstruction. Enclosure bounds and visibility order are checked; exact ancient joinery, hollow interiors and inscriptions are not established.
coffinDepthFit: A common 0.6636799694 vertical depth factor is applied to the fixed three-coffin assembly and every lift-out copy so they fit above the stone interior floor and below its upper rim. Original Meshy files remain unchanged.
